name: LL Review — SPI-CLM record covers the date of service but names a different procedure
description: Eight guided steps, one per row of the LL Review CLM.2 step table: identify the PX_CLM hard edit, note the date of service, find the SPI-CLM limited liability records, open the record whose date range covers the date of service and read its Notes, check the procedure code it names against the claim line and find that it does not match, select the PX_VA bypass code, validate it, and pay the claim under standard benefits.

steps.name: Identify the PX_CLM hard edit
steps.description: Open the Event Resolution tab. It lists every edit on the claim, and PX_CLM is the Hard Edit highlighted with an error indication — the current event to resolve.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Event Resolution tab is opened while this step is active. The workspace opens with no tab selected, so the trainee opens it deliberately.
steps.hint: On 'Event Resolution', the Active Edit section shows Edit Code PX_CLM with a Hard Edit badge, and All Edits lists all six events with PX_CLM marked active.

steps.name: Note the date of service
steps.description: Open the Claim Lines tab and note the date of service billed on Line 1 from its From date and To fields — the service from and through dates. This date is used to find the Limited Liability record that applies. On this claim the date of service on Line 1 is 02/10/2026.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Claim Lines tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: On 'Claim Lines', Line 1 shows From date 02/10/2026 and To 02/10/2026. Keep this date of service for the Limited Liability records.

steps.name: Look up the SPI-CLM LL record
steps.description: Look for an SPI-CLM Limited Liability record. Open the Search tab and its Limited Liability sub-tab. The member's records appear under Limited Liability Results; check the Type column for SPI-CLM. Each row shows the record's Effective date, End date, Order of benefits and Description. This member has two SPI-CLM records. The one that runs 01/01/2026 to 03/31/2026 has no Order of benefits and the Description 'Deny Procedure 36415 as Not Medically necessary with rejection code PX_R23100'.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Search → Limited Liability sub-tab is opened while this step is active. Sub-tabs start closed, so the trainee opens it deliberately.
steps.hint: On 'Search' → 'Limited Liability', read the Type column under Limited Liability Results — both records are SPI-CLM.
steps.checklistItem: Look up the SPI-CLM LL record

steps.name: Open the LL record and read the Notes
steps.description: Identify the LL record whose date range covers the claim's date of service by comparing each record's Effective date and End date against 02/10/2026. The record that runs 07/01/2025 to 12/31/2025 ends before the date of service, so it does not apply — even though its Description names procedure 99213. The record that runs 01/01/2026 to 03/31/2026 covers 02/10/2026, so click its 'Open record' button. Scroll down to the Notes section and read the instruction: 'Deny Procedure 36415 as Not Medically necessary with rejection code PX_R23100'. It means procedure code 36415 should be denied as Not Medically Necessary with rejection code PX_R23100. The criterion to check against the claim is therefore Procedure code 36415.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the SPI-CLM record covering the date of service is opened. The expired record's Open record control dispatches a different action that completes no step.
steps.hint: Click 'Open record' on the SPI-CLM row dated 01/01/2026 – 03/31/2026 — its range covers the 02/10/2026 date of service — then scroll down to Notes.
steps.checklistItem: Open the LL record and read the Notes

steps.name: Match the LL criteria against the claim
steps.description: Check whether the LL record's criterion applies to this claim. The criterion in the covering record's Notes is Procedure code 36415. Return to the Claim Lines tab and check the Procedure on Line 1. On this claim the procedure is 99213, which does not match the LL criterion, so the special instructions do not apply to this claim: do not deny it, and do not use rejection code PX_R23100. The expired record's Description names 99213, but its dates do not cover 02/10/2026, so it does not apply either.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Claim Lines tab is opened while this step is active. The trainee arrives from the Search tab, so the click is a tab change; a Claim Lines visit made while an earlier step is active completes nothing.
steps.hint: On 'Claim Lines', Line 1 shows Procedure 99213 — not 36415 — so the SPI-CLM instruction does not apply to this claim.
steps.checklistItem: Match the LL criteria against the claim

steps.name: Select the PX_VA bypass code
steps.description: Return to the Event Resolution tab and select the bypass code for the PX_CLM event. In the Bypass Codes section, open the Bypass code list and select PX_VA. The other codes in the list do not resolve PX_CLM.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes only when eventResolution.bypassCode is PX_VA. Selecting any other option leaves the step open.
steps.hint: On 'Event Resolution', open the 'Bypass code' select in the Bypass Codes section and choose PX_VA.

steps.name: Validate the bypass code
steps.description: Click the Validate button on the claim summary bar.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when Validate is pressed with PX_VA selected. If the bypass code has been changed to anything else, the press is refused and the Status asks for the bypass code to be reviewed.
steps.hint: Validate sits on the claim summary bar, next to Submit. Click it once PX_VA is selected.

steps.name: Submit Pay decision
steps.description: The SPI-CLM instruction does not apply to this claim, so do not deny it: process it as per the standard guidelines. The claim summary bar shows Allowed $165.00, Co-pay $25.00 and Paid $140.00. Choose Pay from the Action menu in the header, then click Submit on the claim summary bar.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Pay decision is submitted.
steps.hint: Do not deny — the LL instruction names procedure 36415, not this claim's 99213. Choose 'Pay' from the Action menu in the header, then click Submit.
